Evidence from the datasheet: four orderable models (`-35`, `-53`, `-35-I`, `-53-I`); footnotes 1/2 tie Tx/Rx wavelength ranges to `-35` vs `-53` (I-temp variants share the same optics); GbE ↔ 1.25 Gbps and 1G FC ↔ 1.063 Gbps on every SKU.
